memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: God set them in the vault of the sky to give light on the earth, to govern the day and the night, and to separate light from darkness. And God saw that it was good. - Gen 1:17-18 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
I've combined these verses, as they complete one thought about the purpose of the lights God made.

God takes the sun, moon, and stars and sets them in place, each with a task, to give light, to govern day and night, and to separate light from darkness. Every one of them has a job appointed by God, and every one of them does it faithfully, without fail, day after day, night after night. They simply shine where God has placed them.

There is a gentle lesson here for us. God gives light to the world through things He has set in their place. The sun does not wish it were the moon; the stars do not envy the sun. Each shines faithfully in the position God assigned. And in the same way, God has placed you where you are, in your family, your work, your neighbourhood, to give light for Him right there.

You may sometimes feel your place is small or unnoticed. But faithfulness in the position God has given you is precious in His sight. Jesus calls us the light of the world and tells us to let our light shine (Mt 5:14-16). We shine not by drawing attention to ourselves, but by reflecting Him.

And once more God looks and calls it good. Your faithful shining, right where He has set you, is good in His eyes.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where has God "set" you to shine His light right now?
2. Are you content to be faithful in your place, rather than longing to be somewhere else?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You place each light with purpose. Help me shine faithfully right where You have set me, reflecting the light of Christ to those around me. Amen.
